title: JudgmentEvent
description: An immutable event in the Judgment Point lifecycle. Events form the append-only audit log that records every state transition and significant action taken on a Judgment Point. Events are never modified or deleted once created.

judgmentPointId.description: Identifier of the Judgment Point this event belongs to.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project this event belongs to.

eventType.description: The type of lifecycle event. 'created' indicates initial detection as a candidate. 'promoted' indicates the candidate was promoted to a pending Judgment Point. 'investigation-started' indicates structured investigation of alternatives has begun. 'resolution-recorded' indicates a resolution was recorded. 'delegated' indicates resolution authority was delegated. 'dismissed' indicates the Judgment Point was dismissed as not requiring a decision. 'reopened' indicates a previously resolved or dismissed Judgment Point was reopened. 'marked-stale' indicates conditions have changed such that the resolution may no longer be valid. 'dependency-changed' indicates an upstream dependency has changed. 'artifact-linked' indicates an artifact was linked to this Judgment Point. 'artifact-unlinked' indicates an artifact was unlinked from this Judgment Point. 'alternative-added' indicates a new alternative was added. 'comparison-requested' indicates a structured comparison of alternatives was requested. 'comparison-completed' indicates a structured comparison of alternatives was completed. 'validity-condition-changed' indicates a validity condition was added, removed, or modified.

timestamp.description: When this event occurred. Events are ordered by timestamp within a Judgment Point's lifecycle.

actorId.description: Identifier of the user, agent, system component, or policy that caused this event.

actorType.description: The type of actor that caused this event. 'user' is a human user. 'agent' is an AI agent or assistant. 'system' is an automated system component. 'policy' is an automated policy engine applying rules.

payload.description: Event-specific data. The structure of the payload depends on the eventType. For 'created', this may include the initial trigger and materiality assessment. For 'resolution-recorded', this includes the resolution details. For 'artifact-linked', this includes the artifact reference.

correlationId.description: Identifier to correlate this event with other events in the same logical operation.

sessionId.description: Identifier of the user or agent session during which this event occurred.

toolName.description: Name of the tool or skill that was executing when this event occurred.

policyId.description: Identifier of the policy that governed this event, if applicable.

previousStatus.description: The Judgment Point's status before this event.

newStatus.description: The Judgment Point's status after this event.

notes.description: Free-form notes or additional context about this event.

metadata.description: Optional additional context about this event. Metadata fields are not part of the core event model but provide useful information for debugging, auditing, and analysis.
